claims.statement: For every finite well-typed supplied labelled profile with simple induced support H, fixed incidence B, valid fixed support degree/common-neighbor moments, nonempty allowed bit sets on distinct exterior copies and 0<k<v-1, the complete construction using equivalent AND and prefix-threshold gates is satisfiable exactly when a simple labelled SRG(v,k,1,2) completion with that H/B/profile and those supplied pair restrictions exists. Every accepted free-edge assignment has exactly one auxiliary extension. Without nontriviality, the same construction is equivalent to the explicitly stated degree/common-neighbor matrix identity. Removing the pair restrictions requires an independently established necessary-bit premise; the 17+82 application concerns only its one supplied count profile.
assumptions: Finite well-typed distinctly labelled exterior copies, simple symmetric binary induced support H and fixed binary incidence B.
0<k<v-1 whenever conventional nontrivial SRG(v,k,1,2) terminology is used.
Fixed support degrees equal k and each support off-diagonal H^2+BB^T+H entry equals2.
Each extant distinct exterior pair, including two copies of an equal type, has a nonempty allowed set contained in{0,1}.
Every degree/cross/outside-pair equality is emitted completely using the precisely equivalent frozen logical gate/threshold semantics and justified constant normalization.
An unrestricted fixed-profile statement additionally requires supplied pair bits to be necessary for every target completion of that profile.
An actual emitted formula, mapping, byte inventory, runtime, SAT assignment or UNSAT proof requires distinct complete artifact verification.
limitations: Conventional SRG wording is verified only after the explicit0<k<v-1 append-only qualification; original unqualified generic wording is not approved.
Equivalence to completions respecting arbitrary supplied nonempty pair restrictions does not show those restrictions necessary.
One actual count-profile application only; no all-profile/support/family/unrestricted target conclusion.
No emitted CNF, runtime qualification, executed29controls, assignment9801product check or complete proof replay occurs in this written report.
No graph found, target exclusion, numerical solve, formal proof, external review, novelty or registration authority.
The authorcal/source/runtime eligibility and complete byte-level formula-equivalence check remain separate gates.
